_comment: Curated list of OpenAI base models the owned benchmark tracks. Seeded from InferenceCarbon_TokenSec_Daily.xlsx. Reasoning models are expanded across every effort in 'efforts'. `discover` auto-appends NEW major families (family version greater than the current maximum, e.g. gpt-5.6, gpt-6) and their mini/nano/codex siblings; it never re-adds legacy or -pro / codex-max variants. Edit this file by hand to add or remove models.
